crop_center: corrected detector center in original voxels
crop_grid: ceil(64 / original axis spacing) voxels per axis; start floor(center - count/2); intersect image bounds; no padding/rescaling
foreground: deepest physical-EDT voxel of HU >= -400 component nearest center, restricted to detector box, no opening
prompts: same original-space positive point, local point = original - crop_start; no negative or class prompts
mask: label == 1; preserve all output labels; no component cleanup
restore: paste crop labels into original index block; preserve original affine; outside crop = 255 (not evaluated)
validation: research gross-failure gates only; no independent contour ground truth or clinical diameter/category output
